name: pike-language-server
description: IDE-grade Pike tooling — real compiler diagnostics, cross-file navigation, type-aware completion, and Roxen WebServer support out of the box.

scripts.build:extension: bun run scripts/sync-manifest.ts && bash scripts/build-server.sh && bash scripts/build-client.sh
scripts.test:fast: bun test --parallel=4 tests/lsp tests/integration tests/quality-gates tests/tooling server && bun test tests/perf

semanticTokenTypes.description: Built-in Pike functions provided by the runtime or predef

semanticTokenModifiers.description: Mutable variables that can be reassigned

pike.languageServer.path.description: Path to the Pike binary. Must be Pike 8.0 or newer.

pike.languageServer.pikeHome.description: Pike installation root directory (e.g., /usr/local/pike/8.0.1116). When set, overrides auto-detected pikeHome. Leave empty to auto-detect from `pike --show-paths`.

pike.languageServer.modulePaths.description: Additional module search paths (-M). Prepended to auto-detected paths. The workspace root is always included automatically.

pike.languageServer.includePaths.description: Additional include search paths (-I). Prepended to auto-detected paths. The workspace root is always included automatically.

pike.languageServer.programPaths.description: Additional program search paths (for inherit string resolution). Prepended to auto-detected paths. The workspace root is always included automatically.

pike.languageServer.maxNumberOfProblems.description: Maximum number of diagnostic problems reported per file.

pike.languageServer.log.redactPaths.description: Redact absolute file paths and file:// URIs in Pike language server log output.

pike.languageServer.debug.telemetry.description: Log extra diagnostic-lifecycle detail (e.g. why a diagnostic publish was dropped) to the Pike Language Server output channel. Local logging only — this sends nothing over the network and reports nothing to anyone.

pike.languageServer.backgroundIndex.enab.description: Enable background workspace indexing on startup. Disabling speeds up startup but cross-file features (go-to-definition, hover on inherited symbols) won't work until you open the files manually.

pike.languageServer.backgroundIndex.batc.description: Number of files indexed concurrently during background indexing. Higher values use more memory but finish faster. Lower values reduce memory pressure on constrained machines.

pike.languageServer.worker.requestTimeou.description: Timeout (ms) for individual Pike worker requests. Increase for complex codebases that hit timeouts.

pike.languageServer.worker.idleTimeoutMs.description: Idle timeout (ms) before the Pike worker subprocess is killed. Set to 0 to keep it alive indefinitely.

pike.languageServer.worker.maxRequestsBe.description: Force-restart the Pike worker after this many requests, to mitigate memory leaks. Set to 0 to disable.

pike.languageServer.worker.maxActiveMinu.description: Force-restart the Pike worker after this many minutes of activity. Set to 0 to disable.

pike.languageServer.worker.niceValue.description: CPU niceness for the Pike worker on Linux (0–19). Set to 0 to disable. Higher values reduce CPU contention on shared machines.

pike.languageServer.worker.ldLibraryPath.description: Directory to add to LD_LIBRARY_PATH when spawning the Pike worker (e.g. /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu). Set this if the worker logs "Failed to load library" for a shared library — it names the directory that library lives in. Leave empty to auto-detect from the Pike installation (<pike home>/lib).

pike.languageServer.format.insertFinalNe.description: Insert a final newline when formatting.

pike.languageServer.format.operatorSpaci.description: Add spaces around operators when formatting.

pike.languageServer.trace.server.description: Controls the verbosity of LSP protocol tracing to the Output channel. Useful for debugging.

enumDescriptions: Index only open files and their dependency closure (fast startup)
Index the entire workspace on startup (immediate global features)
Index open files first, then background-scan the rest (balanced)
pike.languageServer.indexing.mode.description: Startup indexing strategy. 'openFiles' gives the fastest startup; 'full' provides immediate global features.

pike.languageServer.indexing.ignoreGlobs.description: Glob patterns for files to exclude from workspace indexing (e.g. ["**/vendor/**", "**/.git/**"]).

pike.languageServer.indexing.maxFileSize.description: Maximum file size in bytes for indexing. Files larger than this are skipped.

pike.languageServer.memory.budgetMb.description: Maximum heap in MB before the server enters degraded mode and demotes non-essential index entries.

pike.languageServer.worker.heartbeatInte.description: Interval (ms) between heartbeat signals to the Pike worker. The worker self-terminates if heartbeats stop.

pike.languageServer.worker.watchdogTimeo.description: Timeout (ms) after which the Pike worker self-terminates if no heartbeat is received.

pike.languageServer.hibernation.idleThre.description: Idle period (ms) before the server hibernates: stops Pike, clears non-essential index entries, stays alive.

enumDescriptions: Treat a file as Roxen code when it carries a Roxen marker, sits beside one that does, or lives inside a detected Roxen installation
Treat every Pike file in the workspace as Roxen code
Never treat a file as Roxen code, even inside a Roxen installation
pike.roxen.mode.description: Controls which files get Roxen includes, symbols, and completions.

pike.roxen.path.description: Path to a Roxen installation (the directory containing server/). Leave empty to detect one from pike.json, the workspace's ancestors, or /usr/local/roxen*. Roxen symbols work without an installation; a detected one adds go-to-definition into real sources.
